title: How Vox Group’s AI-Powered Technology Is Solving Real-Time Translation for Group Travel
summary: Vox Group, a 25-year-old guiding technology company operating in over 150 countries, has rebuilt its AI-powered technology called Aura to solve real-time translation for group travel, enabling guides to communicate with mixed-language audiences simultaneously.
problem_solved: Enables a single guide to communicate effectively with tour groups speaking multiple languages simultaneously.
why_valuable: Removes language barriers in the $9+ trillion global tourism industry, improving tour experiences for both guides and international travelers.
